verdict.rationale: Fivetran's own Connector SDK is a supported Python framework for building custom connectors that deploy as an extension of Fivetran rather than as a fork. It comes with a setup guide, a GitHub repo, and AI coding-agent plugins to build, test, and deploy connectors. missing for 10: detailed documentation of SDK depth (auth, pagination, incremental state, schema handling), any low-code/no-code builder option, independent or hands-on corroboration of building a long-tail API connector.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I build a custom connector for a long-tail API with a supported framework or low-code builder, not a fork

citations.quote: Fivetran’s Connector SDK allows you to develop a custom data connector using Python and deploy it as an extension of Fivetran.
Follow our Connector SDK setup guide for custom connectors and visit our Connector SDK GitHub Repo to create a custom source connector and connect it with your destination using Fivetran.
These skills let you build, test, and deploy connectors using natural language prompts.
